description:
FILED s473a (Opus, 2026-09-07) while shipping #1260 / #1243 (c).

`local ${'main::gh'}{a} = 7` and `local ${'main::ga'}[1] = 7` reach the
symbolic-deref branch of Pl::Parser::_process_local_declaration (the branch
tests only Cast + Block/Symbol, and does not look at what follows), where TWO
things go wrong at once and both are silent:

  * it localizes the SCALAR named by the string -- $main::gh -- not the
    element of the deref'd hash;
  * it drops the initializer (the branch returned before the `=` until s473a,
    and s473a's init handling deliberately fires only when the `=` follows the
    deref DIRECTLY, so this shape is untouched).

PROBE (perl 5.40.3 vs PCL at s473a's tip, scratch/s473a/probes/m3b.pl rows
15-16):

  our %gh = (a=>1);
  sub s5 { local ${'main::gh'}{a} = 7; return "in=$gh{a}" }
  print s5(), " after=$gh{a}\n";
    perl  in=7 after=1        PCL  in=1 after=1

  our @ga = (1,2,3);
  sub s6 { local ${'main::ga'}[1] = 7; return "in=$ga[1]" }
    perl  in=7 after=2        PCL  in=2 after=2

FIX SHAPE.  The target is an ELEMENT whose CONTAINER is a symbolic deref, so
the lowering is the existing element machinery (p-local-hash-elem /
p-local-array-slice and their -init twins) with the container form being the
cast the symbolic read already builds -- `(p-cast-% "main::gh")` /
`(p-cast-@ "main::ga")`, from Pl::ExprToCL::_cast_form, which is exactly what
_local_target_item's `elem` arm does for a FOREIGN-QUALIFIED container (task
#700).  So it is a routing, not new mechanism: the branch has to notice a
trailing Structure::Subscript, build the container cast from the deref'd name
and hand the pair to the same element path the unsubscripted spellings use.

Note the sigil rule: `${'name'}{k}` derefs name as a HASH and `${'name'}[i]`
as an ARRAY, exactly as `$h{k}`/`$a[i]` do -- the leading `$` is the
element's sigil, not the container's.

WHY NOT DONE IN s473a: it needs the branch to grow a second target shape and
its own element/slice sub-cases (single key, slice, statement modifier, the
stale-read ordering), which is a second member's worth of work, and the corpus
contains none of it (corpus-diff was IDENTICAL over 111 files both before and
after the #1260 fix).

BAR when taken: the two probe rows plus a slice (`local @{'main::ga'}[0,1]`),
a modifier both ways, `local ${'main::gh'}{a} = ${'main::gh'}{a}` (the
stale-read case), the restore after the scope, and the bare no-init spelling.
Guard rows go in Pl/t/local-symref-01.t beside the #1260 block, which names
this task as the deliberate hole.
subject: SILENT WRONG: `local ${"main::gh"}{a} = 7` (a SUBSCRIPTED symbolic deref) localizes the SCALAR $main::gh instead of the hash element, and drops the initializer -- reads 1 where perl reads 7
